This page tracks how temperature and rainfall pulse across the year for Sarasota and Ulaanbaatar.

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import plotly.express as px
from datetime import datetime
from meteostat import config, hourly

config.block_large_requests = False

start = datetime(2023, 1, 1)
end = datetime(2023, 12, 31, 23, 59)

stations = {
    "Sarasota": "KSRQ0",
    "Ulaanbaatar": "44292",
}

records = []

for city, station in stations.items():
    df = hourly(station, start, end).fetch()
    if df is None or df.empty:
        continue

    df = df.reset_index().rename(columns={"time": "date"})
    df = df[["date", "temp", "prcp"]].dropna()
    df["month_num"] = df["date"].dt.month
    df["month_name"] = df["date"].dt.strftime("%b")

    monthly = (
        df.groupby(["month_num", "month_name"], as_index=False)
        .agg(
            temp_c=("temp", "mean"),
            rainfall_mm=("prcp", "sum")
        )
    )
    monthly["city"] = city
    records.append(monthly)

monthly_df = pd.concat(records, ignore_index=True)
months = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"]
monthly_df["month_name"] = pd.Categorical(monthly_df["month_name"], categories=months, ordered=True)
monthly_df = monthly_df.sort_values(["month_num", "city"]).reset_index(drop=True)
```

## Monthly Temperature Comparison

```{python}
fig_temp = px.line(
    monthly_df,
    x="month_name",
    y="temp_c",
    color="city",
    markers=True,
    category_orders={"city": ["Sarasota", "Ulaanbaatar"], "month_name": months},
    labels={"city": "City", "temp_c": "Temperature (°C)", "month_name": "Month"},
    title="Average Monthly Temperature Across 2023"
)

fig_temp.update_traces(line=dict(width=3), marker=dict(size=8))
fig_temp.layout.yaxis.zeroline = True
fig_temp.layout.yaxis.zerolinewidth = 2
fig_temp.layout.yaxis.zerolinecolor = "gray"
fig_temp.update_layout(
    template="plotly_white",
    width=750,
    height=450,
    colorway=["#1C6E8C", "#D96C06"]
)
fig_temp.show()
```

Notice how Ulaanbaatar dips far below 0°C (freezing) in winter and rises in summer, while Sarasota stays comfortably warm all year.

## Monthly Rainfall Comparison

```{python}
fig_rain = px.line(
    monthly_df,
    x="month_name",
    y="rainfall_mm",
    color="city",
    markers=True,
    category_orders={"city": ["Sarasota", "Ulaanbaatar"], "month_name": months},
    labels={"city": "City", "rainfall_mm": "Rainfall (mm)", "month_name": "Month"},
    title="Total Monthly Rainfall Across 2023"
)

fig_rain.update_traces(line=dict(width=3), marker=dict(size=8))
fig_rain.update_layout(
    template="plotly_white",
    width=750,
    height=450,
    colorway=["#1C6E8C", "#D96C06"]
)
fig_rain.show()
```

Watch the rainfall "pulse" in the summer months: Ulaanbaatar spikes in July, while Sarasota experiences heavy rainfall in August.

## Monthly summary

```{python}
summary = monthly_df.groupby("city").agg(
    avg_temp_c=("temp_c", "mean"),
    total_rainfall_mm=("rainfall_mm", "sum")
).round(2)
summary
```
